title: 液晶空間光調制器
summary: 以 8 µm 像素、1920×1200 的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器為對象，從向列型液晶的雙折射推導 2π 相位行程與單元間隙的關係，計算像素化閃耀光柵的繞射效率與最大偏折角，再把液晶響應時間、相位閃爍、溫度漂移與背板平整度整合成查找表校正與波前修正流程，最後以傅立葉光學系統的驗收指標完成交接。
summaryEn: Taking an 8 µm pixel, 1920×1200 reflective LCOS phase modulator as the object, the course derives the 2π phase stroke against cell gap from nematic birefringence, computes diffraction efficiency and maximum steering angle of pixelated blazed gratings, then folds liquid-crystal response time, phase flicker, temperature drift and backplane flatness into a lookup-table calibration and wavefront-correction flow, closing with acceptance metrics of a Fourier-optics system.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為 532 nm 與 1064 nm 兩用的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器選單元間隙。材料 Δn = 0.20、可用 Δn_eff = 0.15。行程 φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ：d = 3 µm 在 532 nm 給 2π×(2×0.15×3/0.532) = 1.69×2π，在 1064 nm 只有 0.85×2π，不合格；改 d = 4 µm 則 1064 nm 得 1.13×2π，532 nm 得 2.26×2π，兩波長皆可包裹到 2π。代價是響應：τ_off = γ₁d²/(π²K) = 0.1×16×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 16 ms，比 3 µm 的 9 ms 慢 1.8 倍。顯示 8 像素週期（p = 8 µm）閃耀光柵，532 nm 的偏折角 sinθ = 0.532/64 = 0.0083（0.48°），f = 300 mm 時焦點移動 2.5 mm；理論效率 sinc²(1/8) = 95%，乘上反射率 0.90 與填充因子 0.956 得 81.7%。查找表若把 2π 對應到灰階 200，每級 0.0314 rad，可忽略量化損失。相位閃爍 σ = 0.15 rad 時 Strehl ≈ exp(−0.0225) ≈ 0.978。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: choose the cell gap of a reflective LCOS phase modulator meant for both 532 nm and 1064 nm. The material has Δn = 0.20 with usable Δn_eff = 0.15. The stroke φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ: d = 3 µm gives 2π×(2×0.15×3/0.532) = 1.69×2π at 532 nm but only 0.85×2π at 1064 nm, a fail; d = 4 µm gives 1.13×2π at 1064 nm and 2.26×2π at 532 nm, so both wavelengths wrap to 2π. The price is response: τ_off = γ₁d²/(π²K) = 0.1×16×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 16 ms, 1.8 times slower than the 9 ms of a 3 µm cell. Displaying an 8-pixel-period blaze (p = 8 µm) at 532 nm steers by sinθ = 0.532/64 = 0.0083 (0.48°), moving the focus 2.5 mm for f = 300 mm; the theoretical efficiency sinc²(1/8) = 95% times reflectance 0.90 and fill factor 0.956 gives 81.7%. If the lookup table maps 2π to grey level 200, each level is 0.0314 rad and quantization loss is negligible. With phase flicker σ = 0.15 rad, Strehl ≈ exp(−0.0225) ≈ 0.978. Values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙折射與 2π 相位行程」與「像素化繞射與偏折效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 雙折射與 2π 相位行程：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Birefringence and the 2π phase stroke: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「平行配向向列液晶層」如何決定液晶空間光調制器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer” determines the key performance of “Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相位型液晶調制器使用平行配向的向列型液晶：無電場時液晶指向矢平行基板，沿此方向偏振的光感受非常光折射率 n_e；加電壓後指向矢朝電場方向傾斜，有效折射率往尋常光折射率 n_o 下降，穿越厚度 d 的光程隨之改變而偏振態不變，這就是純相位調制。反射式 LCOS 讓光來回穿過液晶層兩次，所以同樣的單元間隙給出兩倍的相位行程；靠近配向層的分子無法完全傾斜，實際可用的折射率差只有材料 Δn 的七到八成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「平行配向向列液晶層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A phase-only liquid-crystal modulator uses a parallel-aligned nematic: with no field the director lies parallel to the substrates and light polarized along it sees the extraordinary index n_e; with voltage the director tilts toward the field, the effective index falls toward the ordinary index n_o, and the optical path through thickness d changes while the polarization state stays fixed, which is pure phase modulation. A reflective LCOS passes light through the layer twice, so the same cell gap gives double the phase stroke; molecules near the alignment layers cannot tilt fully, so the usable index change is only 70 to 80% of the material Δn. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：反射式相位行程 φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The reflective phase stroke is φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相位行程越大越好，所以單元間隙應盡量厚。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger phase stroke is always better, so the cell gap should be as thick as possible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「平行配向向列液晶層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 雙折射與 2π 相位行程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Birefringence and the 2π phase stroke: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平行配向向列液晶層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：反射式相位行程 φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ。Δn = 0.20、可用 Δn_eff = 0.15 時，在 633 nm 達 2π 的最小間隙 d = λ/(2Δn_eff) = 633/0.30 ≈ 2.1 µm；1064 nm 需 3.55 µm；d = 3 µm 的元件在 532 nm 給 1.69×2π，在 1064 nm 只有 0.85×2π，不足一圈。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The reflective phase stroke is φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ. With Δn = 0.20 and usable Δn_eff = 0.15, the minimum gap for 2π at 633 nm is d = λ/(2Δn_eff) = 633/0.30 ≈ 2.1 µm, and 1064 nm needs 3.55 µm; a 3 µm cell gives 1.69×2π at 532 nm but only 0.85×2π at 1064 nm, short of a full cycle. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把調制器放在 45° 交叉偏振片之間，以灰階 0 到 255 掃描並記錄穿透強度，強度隨相位差以 sin²(Δφ/2) 振盪，數振盪週期即可得總相位行程；再換波長重做，確認行程與 1/λ 成正比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the modulator between polarizers at 45°, sweep grey levels from 0 to 255 and record the transmitted intensity, which oscillates as sin²(Δφ/2) with the phase difference; counting the oscillation periods gives the total stroke, and repeating at another wavelength confirms that the stroke scales as 1/λ.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「雙折射與 2π 相位行程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Birefringence and the 2π phase stroke", which statement holds?

steps.title: 雙折射與 2π 相位行程：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Birefringence and the 2π phase stroke: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「平行配向向列液晶層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把調制器放在 45° 交叉偏振片之間，以灰階 0 到 255 掃描並記錄穿透強度，強度隨相位差以 sin²(Δφ/2) 振盪，數振盪週期即可得總相位行程；再換波長重做，確認行程與 1/λ 成正比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the modulator between polarizers at 45°, sweep grey levels from 0 to 255 and record the transmitted intensity, which oscillates as sin²(Δφ/2) with the phase difference; counting the oscillation periods gives the total stroke, and repeating at another wavelength confirms that the stroke scales as 1/λ. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把為可見光選的 2 µm 間隙元件用在 1064 nm，相位只到 1.2π，閃耀光柵的相位包裹處出現 0.8π 的缺口，光被散回零階，繞射效率不到三成。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using a 2 µm gap chosen for the visible at 1064 nm yields only about 1.2π of phase; every wrap of a blazed grating leaves a 0.8π gap, light is thrown back into the zeroth order and diffraction efficiency falls below 30%.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pixel lattice and blazed-grating pattern” determines the key performance of “Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液晶調制器的相位圖是以像素週期 p 取樣的階梯函數，任何圖樣都同時受三個因素限制：相鄰像素的最小週期 2p 決定最大偏折角；一個鋸齒週期內的像素數 N 決定階梯近似閃耀面的效率 sinc²(1/N)；像素間隙與電極邊緣的邊緣電場使相位在像素邊界被平滑，短週期圖樣的實際效率低於純量預測。填充因子以外的面積反射未調制光，成為無法消除的零階。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「像素格點與閃耀光柵圖樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The area outside the fill factor reflects unmodulated light that becomes an irreducible zeroth order. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相位查找表校正」與「相位誤差預算與熱負載」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Phase lookup-table calibration" and "Phase-error budget and thermal load": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相位查找表校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Phase lookup-table calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「灰階對相位查找表」如何決定液晶空間光調制器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grey-level-to-phase lookup table” determines the key performance of “Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驅動電壓與相位之間是非線性的，且隨波長、溫度與元件個體而異，所以每片調制器在每個工作波長都要建立灰階對相位的查找表。常用的繞射法把一半像素固定在灰階 g₀、另一半掃描灰階 g，構成二元光柵，一階強度隨相位差以 sin²(Δφ/2) 變化，由強度曲線反演相位；干涉法則把調制器分成兩區，一區當參考，用相機量條紋位移。目標是讓灰階 0 到 2π 的對應成線性，使相位量化均勻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「灰階對相位查找表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drive voltage and phase are related nonlinearly and the relation changes with wavelength, temperature and device, so every modulator needs a grey-level-to-phase lookup table at each working wavelength. The common diffraction method fixes half of the pixels at grey level g₀ and sweeps the other half through g to form a binary grating whose first-order intensity varies as sin²(Δφ/2) with the phase difference, from which the phase is inverted; the interferometric method splits the modulator into two zones, uses one as reference and reads fringe shifts with a camera. The goal is a linear map from grey level to 0–2π so that phase quantization is uniform. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grey-level-to-phase lookup table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若二元光柵一階強度在灰階 180 時回到零，表示 2π 落在 180 級；重新映射後每級 2π/180 = 0.0349 rad，量化效率 sinc²(1/180) ≈ 99.99%，與 256 級的 0.0245 rad 沒有實質差別。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the first-order intensity of the binary grating returns to zero at grey level 180, 2π sits at 180 levels; after remapping each level is 2π/180 = 0.0349 rad with quantization efficiency sinc²(1/180) ≈ 99.99%, no practical difference from 0.0245 rad at 256 levels.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出廠查找表對任何波長與溫度都適用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 相位查找表校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Phase lookup-table calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灰階對相位查找表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grey-level-to-phase lookup table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若二元光柵一階強度在灰階 180 時回到零，表示 2π 落在 180 級；重新映射後每級 2π/180 = 0.0349 rad，量化效率 sinc²(1/180) ≈ 99.99%，與 256 級的 0.0245 rad 沒有實質差別。校正從 633 nm 換到 532 nm 時相位放大 633/532 = 1.19 倍，必須重做。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the first-order intensity of the binary grating returns to zero at grey level 180, 2π sits at 180 levels; after remapping each level is 2π/180 = 0.0349 rad with quantization efficiency sinc²(1/180) ≈ 99.99%, no practical difference from 0.0245 rad at 256 levels. Moving from 633 nm to 532 nm scales phase by 633/532 = 1.19, so the calibration must be redone. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：完成查找表後顯示 N = 8 像素的閃耀光柵，量一階效率應接近 95% 乘以反射率與填充因子；再把光柵相位整體加 0、π/2、π 的偏置，一階效率不應改變，這證明查找表在整個 0 到 2π 都線性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After building the table, display an N = 8 blazed grating and confirm first-order efficiency near 95% times reflectance and fill factor; then add global offsets of 0, π/2 and π to the grating phase, and the first-order efficiency must not change, proving linearity over the whole 0 to 2π.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 完成查找表後顯示 N = 8 像素的閃耀光柵，量一階效率應接近 95% 乘以反射率與填充因子；再把光柵相位整體加 0、π/2、π 的偏置，一階效率不應改變，這證明查找表在整個 0 到 2π 都線性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 相位誤差預算與熱負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Phase-error budget and thermal load: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「溫度、功率與相位誤差預算表」如何決定液晶空間光調制器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temperature, power and phase-error budget” determines the key performance of “Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 影響輸出波前的誤差來源有五類：查找表殘差、相位閃爍、背板修正殘差、單元間隙漸變與溫度漂移。液晶的雙折射隨溫度上升而下降，相位行程跟著縮，而吸收的雷射功率又會加熱液晶層，所以高功率下相位對灰階的對應會隨時間漂移。各項以均方根相加換算成 Strehl 比，才能決定需要水冷、溫控或定期重校。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「溫度、功率與相位誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Five classes of error affect the output wavefront: lookup-table residual, phase flicker, backplane-correction residual, cell-gap ramp and temperature drift. Liquid-crystal birefringence falls as temperature rises so the phase stroke shrinks, and absorbed laser power heats the layer, so at high power the phase-to-grey mapping drifts over time. The items are root-sum-squared and converted into a Strehl ratio before deciding whether water cooling, temperature control or periodic recalibration is required. knowledge.title: 相位誤差預算與熱負載
knowledge.text: 影響輸出波前的誤差來源有五類：查找表殘差、相位閃爍、背板修正殘差、單元間隙漸變與溫度漂移。液晶的雙折射隨溫度上升而下降，相位行程跟著縮，而吸收的雷射功率又會加熱液晶層，所以高功率下相位對灰階的對應會隨時間漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Five classes of error affect the output wavefront: lookup-table residual, phase flicker, backplane-correction residual, cell-gap ramp and temperature drift. Liquid-crystal birefringence falls as temperature rises so the phase stroke shrinks, and absorbed laser power heats the layer, so at high power the phase-to-grey mapping drifts over time.

steps.title: 傅立葉光學系統整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fourier-optics system integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏振器、傅立葉透鏡與零階擋板」如何決定液晶空間光調制器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Polarizer, Fourier lens and zero-order stop” determines the key performance of “Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整合時把調制器放在傅立葉透鏡的前焦面，目標圖樣就出現在後焦面；入射光須以線偏振對準液晶指向矢，入射角保持在 10° 以內以免相位行程按 cosθ 縮減並混入振幅調制。零階光總是聚在後焦面中心，可用空間擋板遮蔽或在相位圖上加線性相位斜坡把工作圖樣移開。可定址的視場由最大偏折角與焦距決定，光斑大小由孔徑決定，兩者的比值就是可解析點數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振器、傅立葉透鏡與零階擋板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For integration the modulator sits in the front focal plane of a Fourier lens so that the target pattern forms in the back focal plane; the input must be linearly polarized along the director, with incidence kept within 10° so that the stroke is not reduced by cosθ and no amplitude modulation is mixed in. The zeroth order always focuses at the centre of the back focal plane and is either blocked by a spatial stop or pushed aside by adding a linear phase ramp to the pattern. The addressable field follows from maximum steering angle and focal length, the spot size from the aperture, and their ratio is the number of resolvable points. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarizer, Fourier lens and zero-order stop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With f = 300 mm, p = 8 µm and λ = 633 nm the addressable half-field is f·tan(2.27°) ≈ 11.9 mm; the diffraction spot for an aperture D = 1920×8 µm = 15.4 mm is 1.22λf/D = 1.22×0.633×300/15.4 ≈ 15 µm; the number of resolvable points per axis is about N/2 = 960.

quiz.explanation: 交接時要把調制器當成一個帶有校正檔案的光學元件：每個工作波長的查找表、背板修正相位圖、量測的相位行程、響應時間、閃爍、效率對光柵週期曲線與熱漂移斜率，都必須附上量測條件與日期。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At handoff the modulator is treated as an optical element shipped with calibration files: the lookup table for each working wavelength, the backplane correction map, measured stroke, response time, flicker, the efficiency-versus-period curve and the thermal-drift slope, each with measurement conditions and date. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 效率驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Efficiency acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收報告與校正檔案包」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance report and calibration file package” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N = 8 閃耀光柵的期望一階效率 = 0.950×反射率 0.90×填充因子 0.956 ≈ 0.817；實測 0.78 時比值 0.78/0.817 ≈ 0.95，高於 0.90 的驗收門檻；零階殘留應 ≤ 5%，修正後波前 ≤ λ/7 PV，相位閃爍峰對峰 ≤ 0.2 rad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The expected first-order efficiency of an N = 8 blaze is 0.950 × reflectance 0.90 × fill factor 0.956 ≈ 0.817; a measured 0.78 gives a ratio of 0.78/0.817 ≈ 0.95, above the 0.90 acceptance threshold; residual zeroth order must be ≤ 5%, corrected wavefront ≤ λ/7 PV and peak-to-peak phase flicker ≤ 0.2 rad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依序執行：功率計量閃耀效率與零階、干涉儀量修正後波前、光電二極體量閃爍、溫控箱量熱漂移斜率，把結果與校正檔案的雜湊值一起寫入驗收報告；三個月後重量效率，衰減超過 5% 即觸發重新校正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run in order: power-meter blaze efficiency and zeroth order, interferometer corrected wavefront, photodiode flicker and climate-chamber thermal-drift slope; write the results with hash values of the calibration files into the acceptance report, and re-measure efficiency after three months, with a decay beyond 5% triggering recalibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 效率驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Efficiency acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收報告與校正檔案包」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance report and calibration file package” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依序執行：功率計量閃耀效率與零階、干涉儀量修正後波前、光電二極體量閃爍、溫控箱量熱漂移斜率，把結果與校正檔案的雜湊值一起寫入驗收報告；三個月後重量效率，衰減超過 5% 即觸發重新校正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run in order: power-meter blaze efficiency and zeroth order, interferometer corrected wavefront, photodiode flicker and climate-chamber thermal-drift slope; write the results with hash values of the calibration files into the acceptance report, and re-measure efficiency after three months, with a decay beyond 5% triggering recalibration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：系統端只收到一個「2π 可達」的描述而沒有查找表檔案與修正圖，重新用預設線性表驅動後閃耀效率只有 60%，誤以為元件損壞而退貨。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The system team receives only a statement that 2π is reachable, without lookup-table files or the correction map; driving with a default linear table yields 60% blaze efficiency and the device is wrongly returned as damaged.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依序執行：功率計量閃耀效率與零階、干涉儀量修正後波前、光電二極體量閃爍、溫控箱量熱漂移斜率，把結果與校正檔案的雜湊值一起寫入驗收報告；三個月後重量效率，衰減超過 5% 即觸發重新校正。
knowledge.textEn: Run in order: power-meter blaze efficiency and zeroth order, interferometer corrected wavefront, photodiode flicker and climate-chamber thermal-drift slope; write the results with hash values of the calibration files into the acceptance report, and re-measure efficiency after three months, with a decay beyond 5% triggering recalibration.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「效率驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Efficiency acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 效率驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Efficiency acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收報告與校正檔案包」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance report and calibration file package” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 系統端只收到一個「2π 可達」的描述而沒有查找表檔案與修正圖，重新用預設線性表驅動後閃耀效率只有 60%，誤以為元件損壞而退貨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The system team receives only a statement that 2π is reachable, without lookup-table files or the correction map; driving with a default linear table yields 60% blaze efficiency and the device is wrongly returned as damaged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收指標以理論效率扣除反射率與填充因子後的比值表示，才能分辨是元件退化還是系統對準問題；壽命項則追蹤液晶在紫外與高功率下的雙折射衰減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance is expressed as the ratio of measured efficiency to the theoretical value after reflectance and fill factor are removed, so that device degradation can be told from system misalignment; the lifetime item tracks birefringence decay of the liquid crystal under ultraviolet and high power.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「調制器是標準品，不需要隨機附校正檔案。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A modulator is a standard part and needs no device-specific calibration files." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
